entities.summary: Zoran Krušvar is a Croatian psychologist and science fiction and fantasy writer, born on April 9, 1977, in Rijeka. He won 4 SFERA awards, in 2002, in 2003, in 2007 and in 2008 from the Zagreb-based science fiction society SFera.
